content_sections.heading: NeGD MLOps Engineer at a Glance
About National e-Governance Division (NeGD)
content_sections.text: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) is an independent business division under the Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. NeGD plays a pivotal role in supporting MeitY in Programme Management and implementation of e-Governance projects and initiatives undertaken by various Ministries and Departments at both Central and State levels. NeGD spearheads several innovative initiatives under the aegis of the Digital India Programme.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: B. Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related discipline Certifications in DevOps or Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) preferred. Research papers, case studies, or significant open-source contributions (are preferred) Experience: 3–6 years in operationalizing AI/ML models with proven experience in CI/CD automation. Prior exposure to deploying ML pipelines for NLP, computer vision, or speech systems. Familiarity with monitoring, model lifecycle management, and performance logging.

content_sections.heading: NeGD MLOps Engineer Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be responsible for the following duties and responsibilities as outlined in the official notification: Deploy and manage AI/ML models in development, staging, and production environments Build and maintain automated pipelines for continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) Implement real-time monitoring for model drift, latency, and inference performance Collaborate with the Solution Architect and MLOps Lead to standardize deployment infrastructure Ensure reproducibility, rollback, and version control for deployed models Integrate AI services with NeGD’s standard APIs and observability frameworks Maintain deployment logs, error reports, and environment snapshots for audit readiness
